title: Web: keep wrapped lines' tabs in place
body:
**Intent:** fix the bug the reviewer found in [#29](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/29). #29 auto-merged on green CI 19 seconds before its review, which requested changes, landed.

**Behavior change:** with wrapping on (the default), lines indented with tabs no longer shift 2ch left.
- **Cause:** tab stops are measured from the padded edge, so a hang of indent + 2ch put the first row 2ch before a tab stop.
- **Fix:** the hang is now rounded up to a whole tab stop. Tabs in the indentation also count as moving to the next stop, so a mix like "2 spaces + tab" is measured correctly.

**Tests:** measured in headless Chromium with the real CSS, with wrapping on and off. The cases were two tabs, eight spaces, one tab, four spaces, "2 spaces + tab", a tab mid-line, and three spaces. Every marker lands at the same x with wrapping on and off (before the fix, the tab cases were 15px off). `pnpm verify` and e2e pass.

**Tier 1:** `apps/web`.

**Known gaps:**
- There's no permanent regression test for tabs. The e2e fixture has no tab-indented lines, and `apps/web` has no unit test project yet; adding one is a config change, which is code-owned.
- The process gap that let #29 merge before its review is reported to the maintainer separately.
